subtitle: Insert and Input Recorder
tagline: Records exactly what reaches a DAW insert or a standalone input, without changing the sound, then converts and splits the result into WAV, FLAC, AIFF, MP3, AAC, or Ogg files.

body.lead: TB Recorder captures exactly what reaches its insert point in your DAW, or a standalone audio input. Choose a folder and a file name, press RECORD, and mono or stereo audio is saved while the sound passing through stays unchanged.

body.p: You can pause and resume without closing the recording; metering and passthrough continue, and the paused time is left out of the final duration and the split points. When you stop, TB Recorder finishes the recording and converts and divides it into the format and lengths you chose.

ul: Records mono or stereo audio at the insert point without altering it
Six formats: WAV 32-bit float, FLAC 24-bit, AIFF 24-bit, MP3 320 kbps, AAC-LC 192 kbps, Ogg Vorbis 320 kbps
Splitting into 1, 5, 10, or 30-minute parts, a custom length, or unlimited
PAUSE and RESUME without closing the recording
Level meters, status, and elapsed time
Standalone mode with audio device and input settings

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Recorder 1.0.1 for Windows (VST3 and standalone). The current macOS build is version 1.0.2, where MP3 and AAC are not available; other details may also differ.

ol: Insert TB Recorder on the track or bus you want to capture, at the point in the chain you want to record.
Click `CHOOSE...` {{5}} and pick the folder for finished recordings, then type a `FILE NAME` {{6}}.
Choose `FORMAT` and `SPLIT` {{7}}. The defaults are `WAV FLOAT` (32-bit float WAV) and `UNLIMITED`.
Start playback and press `RECORD` {{9}}. Press `PAUSE` to pause and `RESUME` to continue.
Press `STOP`. Wait until CONVERTING finishes and the status returns to READY before you close the session.

In a DAW, the plug-in records its insert input. In standalone mode, INPUT DEVICE... opens the audio device and input settings.

note.text: The settings are not host-automatable. FILE NAME and OUTPUT FOLDER are stored with the plug-in state. MP3 and AAC use the Windows Media Foundation encoders; if your system lacks them, those formats fail.

body.p: The preset list holds Init and your saved recorder settings. Save stores the current recorder settings as a user preset. Presets cannot be saved or loaded while the recorder is busy.

rows: Brought the latest Recorder build to Windows VST3, including the current recording status display and pause and resume, and aligned the catalog, VST3, and installer versions at 1.0.1.
First release: records the unaltered mono or stereo signal at the insert point, with WAV, FLAC, AIFF, MP3, AAC, and Ogg conversion and automatic time-based splitting.
